title: KP14 vyg25s with the loadings TRIPLED: six types -0.42, -0.21, -0.06, 0.06, 0.21, 0.42, level-compensated, price 2.5
question: Does the KP14 room/gap keep rising with the loading size past x2, or does the wider level compensation (type_theta 1..37) make the type linearly visible?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30). vyg25sx2 (loadings x2) raised the oracle room from vyg25s's +0.35 to +0.45 (5 seeds) and the fair gap from +0.181 to +0.257 (4 seeds, t 10.3), with the linear ceiling falling (0.07-0.27 vs 0.10-0.28): in KP14 the level compensation changes only the characteristics' scale, so a larger hidden loading deepens the hump without revealing the type. The GS21 and BGN rungs did not behave this way (gvy25sx2 null, bvychsx2 ~= bvychsx3 ~ +0.10). This is the next KP14 rung.

FEASIBILITY (parameters_kp14 at these overrides, 2026-10-30): A0 finite for all six types (27.5 to 1.34 pre-compensation at y = 0); type_theta 1 to 37.4 (x2: 1 to 11.2); rho0 min 0.0158 unchanged. Premium b.gamma from -1.05 to +1.05.
